# llms.txt — DailyAIWire.news
# AI Crawler Guidance (llms.txt Standard)
# https://llmstxt.org/

> DailyAIWire.news is an autonomous AI intelligence platform that synthesizes,
> analyzes, and distributes AI industry news. All content is AI-processed with
> human editorial oversight and EU AI Act Art. 50 compliance labeling.

## API Endpoints

### Intelligence Feed
- Endpoint: `GET https://dailyaiwire.news/api/intelligence`
- Format: JSON
- Parameters: `limit` (1-50, default 10), `category`, `min_score` (50-100), `since` (ISO date)
- Rate Limit: 60 requests/minute
- No authentication required

### Article Detail
- Endpoint: `GET https://dailyaiwire.news/api/intelligence/{slug}`
- Format: JSON
- Returns: Full article with deep analysis, key details, and source attribution

### Search
- Endpoint: `GET https://dailyaiwire.news/api/search?q={query}`
- Format: JSON
- Supports semantic (Qdrant) and keyword fallback search

### Trends
- Endpoint: `GET https://dailyaiwire.news/api/trends`
- Format: JSON
- Returns: Category velocity, trending hashtags, emerging keywords

## Content Structure

Each article contains:
- `title` — AI-generated headline
- `gist` — One-sentence summary (max 25 tokens)
- `why_it_matters` — Impact analysis
- `key_details` — Array of verifiable facts
- `deep_analysis` — 300+ word comprehensive analysis
- `category` — One of: LLMs, Robotics, Business, Tools, Policy, Science, Security, Society, Ethics, AI Agents
- `importance_score` — 50-100 strategic value rating
- `source` — Original source attribution
- `source_url` — Link to primary source

## RSS Feed
- URL: `https://dailyaiwire.news/rss.xml`
- Format: RSS 2.0 with enclosures

## Sitemap
- URL: `https://dailyaiwire.news/sitemap.xml`
